clauses: This highly decorated figure passed away in Moscow.

Throughout a distinguished career, they received numerous prestigious accolades, including the Order of Lenin, the Hero of Socialist Labour, the Lenin Prize, the Stalin Prize, the Order of the October Revolution, the Order of the Red Banner of Labour, and the Medal "For Valiant Labour in the Great Patriotic War 1941–1945".
However, this individual never served as a deputy of the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union and was never awarded the IEEE Alexander Graham Bell Medal.
